title: Credential requirements manifest
description: Declares every credential an effect needs before it runs (ADR-SEC-0001). Each entry names the credential by the exact secret or variable name, its kind, the scope the consuming effect requires, the workflow job, action, or command that consumes it, and whether absence blocks the effect or degrades it. The manifest carries names only: no property of any entry may hold a value, and every object is closed so a `value` key is rejected. DEVAI verifies presence, shape, and scope through the consuming tool's own status command; it never reads a value except at the subprocess boundary that consumes it, never stores one, and never generates a key.

credential_id.description: The exact secret or environment variable name as the consumer spells it (`secrets.NAME`, `$NAME`). The GitHub Actions token is `GITHUB_TOKEN` whether a workflow writes `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` or `github.token`.

credential_kind.description: `environment`: a variable of the executing shell. `repository-secret`: a GitHub Actions secret bound to the repository. `environment-secret`: a GitHub Actions secret bound to a protected deployment environment. `gh-auth`: the GitHub token of the job or the local `gh` session, probed with `gh auth status`. `file`: a credential file on the host at a path the consumer resolves, probed for existence only.

absence.description: `block`: the consuming effect stops before any build or verification step when the credential is absent. `degrade`: the effect runs with the capability the credential enables switched off and reports it.

workflow_consumer.description: A GitHub Actions job that references the credential.

job.description: The job key under `jobs:` whose steps reference the credential.

action_consumer.description: A DEVAI action whose effect consumes the credential through a subprocess.

command_consumer.description: An operator command outside the action registry, such as the package installation that precedes the first DEVAI action.

command.description: The command line the operator runs, without any credential value.

entry.description: One credential requirement. Names only; a `value` key is rejected.

scope.description: The scope the consumer requires, in the vocabulary of the issuing system: a GitHub token scope such as `read:packages` or `issues:write`, a workflow permission set such as `contents:write packages:write`, or a DEVAI role such as `signing` or `ledger-input`.

consumer.description: Every effect that references the credential. A workflow checker requires a bijection between workflow secret references and the workflow consumers declared here.

description.description: What the credential authorizes and who provisions it. Never a value, a fragment of a value, or a hint at one.

id.description: Manifest identity, such as `credential-requirements` for DEVAI's own manifest or `credential-requirements-binding` for an adopter binding.

authority.description: The role that owns the manifest and approves changes to it.

entries.description: One entry per credential name. Consumers accumulate on the entry instead of repeating the name.
Read-only GitHub Packages access used to install the pinned DEVAI verifier. Provisioned by the repository owner; never falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN.
The local gh session that projects round state onto GitHub issues. Without it tracking sync reports unauthenticated and writes nothing.
